unk_label: counted by the SoS, not yet in the party data
party_methods_note: The party figures (UF Election Lab, from Political Data Inc) cover mail and in-person ballots together, so party is shown for all ballots cast and for outstanding mail ballots, not for mail returned or in person separately.
map_note: Returned ballots (7,752,140 of them accepted so far after signature checks). 'Issued' counts every voter sent a ballot, including some who have since moved or been inactivated, so 'outstanding' runs slightly high. Party (statewide only): UF Election Lab, from Political Data Inc (as of 11/5/2026), for mail and in-person ballots together -- 10,311,597 of the ballots cast have a party (more than the SoS's 9,305,860; the party data is ahead). Counties are shown without party.

source.primary: California Secretary of State VBM Ballot Statistics (data through 2026-11-03 23:59 PT); registered voters: 15-day Report of Registration; statewide party split: UF Election Lab (Political Data Inc), CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
